name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)

eligibility.other_conditions: Individual must have a savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent enabled.

benefits: Accidental death and full permanent disability cover of Rs 2 Lakh, and partial disability cover of Rs 1 Lakh at an affordable premium of only Rs 20 per annum auto-debited from bank account.
documents_required: Bank Account Details with Auto-Debit Mandate
application_process: Submit PMSBY enrollment form to your bank branch or activate via internet banking / SMS.
Authorize annual auto-debit of Rs 20 in the month of May.
Bank issues policy certificate and registers risk coverage with public sector general insurance company.
